_comment: The declared label set for this repository -- one source, so CONTRIBUTING.md's
issue standard cannot cite a label that does not exist (issue #109: it cited
`docs`, which is really `documentation`, and `loop`, which had never been
created, while omitting `performance` and `research`, which were in use).
type            -- an issue carries exactly one; this is the 'one label
modifier        -- optional, stacks on a type label.
area            -- where in the code the issue lives; zero or more.
priority        -- at most one of high / medium / low.
github-default  -- shipped by GitHub when the repository was created and
kept only so this file is a complete inventory. Not part
of the standard; nothing here is expected to use them.
Colours are hex without the leading '#', matching `gh label list --json color`.
against this file; .github/workflows/labels.yml checks this file against the

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Improvements or additions to documentation

labels.name: eval
labels.description: Gold cases, grading and the measurement gate

labels.name: loop
labels.description: The self-improvement harness: search, ledger, campaigns

labels.name: performance
labels.description: Latency, throughput and resource use

labels.name: research
labels.description: Exploration with a written conclusion

labels.name: cleanup
labels.description: Removing dead weight from the repo

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Good for newcomers

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Extra attention is needed

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: This doesn't seem right

labels.name: question
labels.description: Further information is requested

labels.name: security
labels.description: Hardening or a vulnerability; suspected leaks go through SECURITY.md

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Cannot move until something external happens; the issue says what

labels.name: needs-gate
labels.description: Touches retrieval or generation: the full eval gate must be green before merge

labels.name: needs-decision
labels.description: Waits on an owner decision (protected zone or a design choice)

labels.name: area:core

labels.name: area:adapters

labels.name: area:indexing
labels.description: Corpus indexing, chunking and the index fingerprint

labels.name: area:retrieval
labels.description: Hybrid search, reranking and context assembly

labels.name: area:generation
labels.description: Prompts, RECOMP, streaming and citations

labels.name: area:web
labels.description: Flask backend and its API

labels.name: area:frontend
labels.description: React frontend in rag/web/frontend

labels.name: area:headless
labels.description: Headless HTTP service for other apps

labels.name: area:desktop

labels.name: area:study

labels.name: area:ci

labels.name: priority:high

labels.name: priority:medium

labels.name: priority:low
labels.description: Worth doing when adjacent work is open
